verdict.rationale: Ollama's own homepage nearly restates the story: it promises dedicated capacity so throughput holds when several agents run at once, and its pricing page advertises running multiple models concurrently. That is only a one-line marketing claim, apparently tied to a paid or cloud tier, with no documented mechanism, limits or guarantees. missing for 10: technical documentation of how capacity is reserved and what concurrency or throughput limits apply, clarity on which plans or local versus cloud deployments it covers, independent or hands-on benchmarks of throughput under concurrent sessions.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know the runtime reserves dedicated capacity so throughput holds steady when multiple agents or sessions issue requests concurrently

citations.quote: Dedicated capacity so throughput holds up when you are running several agents at once.
